universities.summary: Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute is a private deemed-to-be university in Chennai, with origins in 1988 and university status from 2003. Its Chennai faculties offer regular arts, science, commerce, social science and hospitality study alongside separate professional faculties. Programme entry, specialisation and campus scope differ across the university and its constituent institutions.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Chennai university contact campus is at Maduravoyal on E.V.R. Periyar Salai. Arts and science departments publish regular coursework and practical curricula alongside student academic activities. Confirm the actual teaching block with the department; ARNI off-campus and Bengaluru constituent-college entries have separate location and admission scope.
universities.cityProfile: The university’s Chennai address is Maduravoyal on E.V.R. Periyar Salai, while its corporate office is in T-Nagar. These are different locations. Use the assigned teaching campus when planning daily travel, accommodation and reporting, rather than treating the corporate office or another group institution as the study location.
universities.practicalExposure: The faculty regulations combine core subjects with practical learning, projects, internships and skill courses as prescribed by the curriculum. They also provide for programme-level assessments and faculty advising. The actual practical component differs across laboratory science, computing, media, commerce, social science and hospitality degrees; confirm the selected curriculum and department arrangements. An academic award does not by itself confer a regulated professional licence or employment entitlement.
universities.hostelOverview: The university prospectus describes separate hostels for male and female students, furnished rooms, dining areas, laundry facilities, Internet access and resident staff. Confirm the hostel serving the assigned teaching block, room availability, allocation rules and complete charges before arranging a stay. Accommodation is separate from the published programme-fee range.
universities.dietarySupport: The prospectus describes campus canteens serving South and North Indian meals and other food options. Check current mess or canteen availability, special dietary requirements and charges for the assigned teaching campus; food costs are separate from the programme-fee quotation.
universities.safetyOverview: The hostel description identifies security staff, surveillance cameras, access control and resident support. These measures do not guarantee safety; ask for current reporting rules, local emergency contacts and grievance support for the assigned campus.
universities.studentSupport: The university describes library print and electronic resources, study facilities and student support services. Faculty regulations provide academic counselling and advisers. Confirm access, timing and assistance with the chosen department and teaching campus.

faq.question: Which university is this?
faq.answer: This is Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, a deemed-to-be university with its Chennai contact campus at Maduravoyal. It is separate from the Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University and other institutions using the MGR name.

faq.question: Which campus does this listing cover?
faq.answer: These entries cover regular Chennai university faculties. ARNI off-campus, Bengaluru constituent medical colleges, online programmes and other group institutions have separate scope; confirm the teaching block named in the admission offer.

faq.question: What are the usual degree durations?
faq.answer: The faculty regulations define the standard undergraduate route as three years and postgraduate study as two years. Honours, integrated, professional, part-time and lateral-entry routes require their own duration and are not inferred from that standard.

faq.question: What language is used?
faq.answer: The 2022 faculty regulations specify English instruction, examinations and project reports. The common rules except language courses from the English requirement. Tamil, Hindi or French language degrees require their own medium verification.

faq.question: Which academic qualifications are needed?
faq.answer: Requirements differ by degree. Computing routes can require Mathematics, laboratory sciences specify relevant school subjects, and postgraduate degrees name qualifying prior awards. Read the qualification attached to the exact offering before applying.

faq.question: Why do some entries name a narrower qualifying route?
faq.answer: Some university eligibility statements differ by source. Those entries cover the prior qualification supported by both statements; they do not establish that every other applicant is prohibited. Ask the university to confirm additional pathways.

faq.question: What does the displayed programme fee cover?
faq.answer: The university publishes course-fee ranges by award category and says charges vary by specialisation and academic pattern. These are not isolated tuition amounts. Obtain the itemised final offer and budget separately for accommodation, food, transport and personal costs.

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Register through the official university admission portal, select the exact Chennai programme and follow the application login instructions. The university’s process includes counselling, qualifying-document verification, enabled payments and final document submission before admission documentation is issued.

faq.question: Are entrance examinations the same for all degrees?
faq.answer: No common entrance examination is asserted for these regular arts and science entries. Follow the assessment or selection instructions issued for the exact programme; professional faculties and other routes have separate requirements.

faq.question: Can international students use these entries?
faq.answer: These entries verify the domestic route. The university has general international guidance, including qualification-equivalence and English-language conditions, but exact programme availability and international charges require university confirmation.

faq.question: Is hostel accommodation included?
faq.answer: Accommodation is separate from the programme quotation. The prospectus describes men’s and women’s hostels; ask about the hostel serving the actual teaching block, allocation, room options, meals, deposits and current charges.

faq.question: When does the next intake start?
faq.answer: Use the university’s newly notified application and reporting schedule. An exact next first-entry month is not independently established here, and these entries do not promise an open or future admission window.
